cases.name: tabs-page
cases.prompt: In this Diplodoc project, create a page docs/install.md titled 'Installation' with installation instructions shown as tabs for three platforms: Linux, macOS and Windows (one shell command each, e.g. a package manager install line). Register the page in the table of contents. Follow the YFM skill.

cases.name: multiline-table
cases.prompt: In this Diplodoc project, add a section 'Support matrix' to docs/index.md with a table where the first column cell 'Linux' spans two rows (rows: x64 supported, arm64 supported) and a third row 'Windows' with a single cell spanning the remaining two columns saying 'not supported'. Use the table syntax from the YFM skill that supports merged cells.

cases.name: terms
cases.prompt: In docs/index.md of this Diplodoc project, mention the abbreviation 'TVM' twice in the text and make it a clickable term popup that explains it as 'Ticket Vending Machine, an internal auth protocol'. Use the term syntax from the YFM skill.

cases.name: new-page-in-toc
cases.prompt: In this Diplodoc project, create a page docs/faq.md with three frequently asked questions (each question as a collapsible block) and link to it from docs/index.md. Make sure the project still builds.

cases.name: no-unsupported-syntax
cases.prompt: In docs/index.md of this Diplodoc project, add a 'Sources' section: a paragraph of text with two footnote-style source references and a small to-do list of three items for the reader. Use only syntax that renders in Diplodoc by default, per the YFM skill.
